card.name: Inside names of societies and study groups
card.fires_on: The second or later word inside a capitalized organization, society, journal or study-group name, such as Society of Environmental, University Group Diabetes Program or Women's Health Initiative. It often sits on words like Environmental, Physical, Family, Group, Health or "the".

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing the rest of a proper organization name and away from survey or respondent words.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of the full name of an association, study or journal, before the name is finished.
